entries.f6f9e72f12d5948d: With growth and development as its main theme, the company states that it will work on strengthening and expanding domestic business, re-entering overseas markets, and improving management efficiency. Its main initiatives are, in unit houses, strengthening openings of permanent and satellite exhibition halls, promoting used sales, and improving the efficiency of the ordering system using AI; in modular and system construction, promoting collaboration, strengthening proposal capability through use of 3D estimation systems and VR tools and AI tools, and expanding modular construction exhibition halls; and in construction machinery rental, active investment in profitable products and strengthening of human resources. It states that it aims to establish itself as a "lightweight steel frame general contractor" in the low-rise construction market.
